title: Skill Frontmatter v1
description: YAML frontmatter block for a lamella skill file. Declares identity, tooling constraints, licensing, and optional agentskills.io interop metadata. Produced by skill authors; consumed by the lamella validator and any compatible skill registry.

name.description: Kebab-case identifier for the skill. Must be unique within the owning skill set. Used as the canonical key in registry lookups and install references.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the skill does. Shown in marketplace listings, skill pickers, and operator dashboards.

compatibility.description: Free-text compatibility statement for agentskills.io interop. Describes the agent environment this skill targets. Not validated semantically; consumers should treat unknown values gracefully.

license.description: SPDX license identifier or short license name under which this skill is distributed. Examples: 'MIT', 'Apache-2.0', 'Proprietary'.

oneOf.description: A single tool name permitted for use by this skill.
List of tool names permitted for use by this skill.

allowed-tools.description: Tool allowlist for this skill. Restricts which tools an agent may invoke when running the skill. Accepts a single string or an array of non-empty strings.

metadata.description: Arbitrary string key-value pairs for producer-defined or registry-specific metadata. All values must be strings. Consumers should tolerate unknown keys.
